correctness.rationale: Unique greedy arches have one a each because there are exactly k copies and k complete arches. Exhaustive arch forms ab or b^(h+1)a and trailing b^e yield bijective coefficient factors. Baseline and all excess ab pairs are enumerated without omission. Exact binomial totals, fixed-s moments, and Stirling denominator give stated asymptotic; word reversal supplies symmetry. 35 independent complete-word histogram cases and 160 integer-algebra cases corroborate indexing and normalization.

value.rationale: The result determines exact positive cardinalities within natural binary Parikh matrix fibers at a near-minimal multiplicity boundary and gives a complete simultaneous probability distribution for arbitrary k,s,C, not only nonemptiness or aggregate finite length. Its explicit exponential rarity constant for every fixed slack is a meaningful quantitative boundary phenomenon for subsequence universality and motivates extension to general compositions.
